title: Afcons Infrastructure Ltd. v. Nagpur Metro Rail Corporation Ltd.
bench: Madan B. Lokur aur R.K. Agrawal, JJ. (faisla: Madan B. Lokur, J.)
summary: Nagpur Metro ke tender mein ek JV ki technical bid 'metro' ke anubhav ki shart par disqualify hui. High Court ne disqualification palat di thi. Supreme Court mein appeal hui.
held: Tender likhne wala employer hi uski shartein sabse achhe se samajhta hai, aur court uski vyakhya maanega jab tak mala fide ya perversity na ho (para 15). Interference sirf mala fide, kisi ko fayda pahunchane ki neeyat, ya ghor arbitrariness par ho (para 11, 13). Appeals allowed.
use: Para 13 aur 15: Nagar Palika ki tender shartein aur unki vyakhya mein court ka dakhal seemit hai.
caution: Yeh faisla eligibility ki vyakhya par hai, domicile jaisi Article 14 wali shart par nahi. AMT kahega ki domicile wali shart khud 'arbitrary' hai.
